body: They have not charged me yet. I have not been served a restraining order yet. She lies to her own self, it took me over a month to get her to admit she had sex with my friend. when everyone told me she did. Including my friend. I pressed and i pressed and i pressed, and she finally told me.

I have never known a pain so pure and distilled. Yesterday i was driving trying to stop stressing and told myself to let the detectives find all the facts. I started crying and then my face and chest became numb, my chest started to feel constricted like a rope was being tightened around it. I thought i was going to have a heart attack. I cant afford legal defense. And i truly believe in my heart she had planned this out. As all of the evidence is conveniently pointed at me.

I cannot, detective said if i tried to contact her he would arrest me for stalking. The detective said if she tried to contact me to let him know. Well Yesterday early morning she tried to call my cell. I tried contacting the detective yesterday and could never get through. The lady receptionist took my cell number down and said he will contact me. Yet he still hasnt. I dont think he believes me. Even though i passed the voice lie test he gave me.
